title_vi: should; ôn tập động từ khuyết thiếu
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 83: Tick the correct sentences.

Bài 83: Đánh dấu các câu đúng.

Exercise 84: There are mistakes in five of these sentences. Correct the sentences where necessary. Write ‘OK’ if the sentence is already correct.

Bài 84: Năm trong số các câu này có lỗi. Sửa câu khi cần. Viết ‘OK’ nếu câu đã đúng.

Exercise 85: Complete the conversation with should where necessary. Leave out should where possible.

Bài 85: Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại với should khi cần. Bỏ should khi có thể.

Exercise 86: Use your own ideas to complete the sentences.

Bài 86: Dùng ý của bạn để hoàn thành câu.

Exercise 87: Read this notice. Then complete the advice for people who are coming to your school or place of work.

Bài 87: Đọc thông báo. Rồi hoàn thành lời khuyên cho người mới đến trường hoặc nơi làm việc của bạn.

mcq.question: After a match, the captain insists the football team ___ take things easy.
mcq.full: After a match, the captain insists the football team should take things easy.
mcq.vi: Sau trận đấu, đội trưởng yêu cầu cả đội nên nghỉ ngơi thư giãn.
mcq.expl:
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + base form; not insist / suggest + somebody to …; it’s odd that … + should or normal verb; if … should = if by any chance.
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + động từ nguyên mẫu; không dùng insist / suggest + ai đó + to …; it’s odd that … + should hoặc động từ thường; if … should = nếu chẳng may.
Điểm ngữ pháp: insist + (should) + V; không dùng insist + O + to V.
mcq.key: After a match, the captain insists the football team ___ take things easy.|should

mcq.question: If you really want to get rich fast, I suggest you ___ work harder.
mcq.full: If you really want to get rich fast, I suggest you should work harder.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn thật sự muốn giàu nhanh, tôi đề nghị bạn nên làm việc chăm hơn.
mcq.expl:
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + base form; not insist / suggest + somebody to …; it’s odd that … + should or normal verb; if … should = if by any chance.
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + động từ nguyên mẫu; không dùng insist / suggest + ai đó + to …; it’s odd that … + should hoặc động từ thường; if … should = nếu chẳng may.
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest + (should) + V; không dùng suggest + O + to V.
mcq.key: If you really want to get rich fast, I suggest you ___ work harder.|should

mcq.question: He never has any money, so it’s very odd that he ___ a new car.
mcq.full: He never has any money, so it’s very odd that he has a new car.
mcq.vi: Anh ta chẳng bao giờ có tiền, nên thật lạ là anh ta có xe mới.
mcq.expl:
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + base form; not insist / suggest + somebody to …; it’s odd that … + should or normal verb; if … should = if by any chance.
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + động từ nguyên mẫu; không dùng insist / suggest + ai đó + to …; it’s odd that … + should hoặc động từ thường; if … should = nếu chẳng may.
Điểm ngữ pháp: it’s odd that + động từ thường (hoặc should have), không dùng nguyên mẫu have.
mcq.key: He never has any money, so it’s very odd that he ___ a new car.|has

mcq.question: I think the weather will stay dry, but you can borrow my raincoat if by any chance it ___.
mcq.full: I think the weather will stay dry, but you can borrow my raincoat if by any chance it rains.
mcq.vi: Tôi nghĩ trời sẽ khô ráo, nhưng bạn có thể mượn áo mưa của tôi nếu chẳng may trời mưa.
mcq.expl:
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + base form; not insist / suggest + somebody to …; it’s odd that … + should or normal verb; if … should = if by any chance.
insist / demand / suggest / important (that) + (should) + động từ nguyên mẫu; không dùng insist / suggest + ai đó + to …; it’s odd that … + should hoặc động từ thường; if … should = nếu chẳng may.
Điểm ngữ pháp: if by any chance + hiện tại đơn (hoặc should rain).
mcq.key: I think the weather will stay dry, but you can borrow my raincoat if by any chance it ___.|rains

mcq.question: We were very surprised that Tom ___ in such a rude manner.
mcq.full: We were very surprised that Tom behaved in such a rude manner.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi rất ngạc nhiên khi Tom cư xử thô lỗ như vậy.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: surprised that + quá khứ (hoặc should behave).
mcq.key: We were very surprised that Tom ___ in such a rude manner.|behaved

mcq.question: I asked a friend about getting train tickets and he recommended ___ online.
mcq.full: I asked a friend about getting train tickets and he recommended booking online.
mcq.vi: Tôi hỏi một người bạn về việc mua vé tàu và cậu ấy khuyên đặt vé trực tuyến.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: recommend + V-ing / recommend (that) I (should) book.
mcq.key: I asked a friend about getting train tickets and he recommended ___ online.|booking

mcq.question: The government accepted the recommendation that they ___ spending on the armed services.
mcq.full: The government accepted the recommendation that they reduce spending on the armed services.
mcq.vi: Chính phủ chấp nhận khuyến nghị rằng họ cắt giảm chi tiêu quân sự.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: recommendation that + (should) + V.
mcq.key: The government accepted the recommendation that they ___ spending on the armed services.|reduce

mcq.question: If I can’t use a phone here, how do you suggest ___ my office?
mcq.full: If I can’t use a phone here, how do you suggest I contact my office?
mcq.vi: Nếu tôi không được dùng điện thoại ở đây, bạn đề nghị tôi liên lạc với văn phòng bằng cách nào?
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest (that) I (should) contact.
mcq.key: If I can’t use a phone here, how do you suggest ___ my office?|I contact

mcq.question: I ___ go in there if I were you. They’re having an argument about money.
mcq.full: I shouldn’t go in there if I were you. They’re having an argument about money.
mcq.vi: Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không vào đó. Họ đang cãi nhau về tiền bạc.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: I shouldn’t (wouldn’t) … if I were you = lời khuyên.
mcq.key: I ___ go in there if I were you. They’re having an argument about money.|shouldn’t

mcq.question: ___ off when you call, just leave a message on voicemail.
mcq.full: Should my phone be off when you call, just leave a message on voicemail.
mcq.vi: Nếu điện thoại tôi tắt khi bạn gọi, cứ để lại tin nhắn thoại.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Should + chủ ngữ + V = If … (đảo ngữ).
mcq.key: ___ off when you call, just leave a message on voicemail.|Should my phone be

mcq.question: It’s essential that I ___ the doctor today.
mcq.full: It’s essential that I should see the doctor today.
mcq.vi: Điều thiết yếu là tôi phải gặp bác sĩ hôm nay.
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: essential that + (should) + V.
mcq.key: It’s essential that I ___ the doctor today.|should see

mcq.question: Why didn’t you demand ___ your subscription?
mcq.full: Why didn’t you demand that the club refund your subscription?
mcq.vi: Sao bạn không yêu cầu câu lạc bộ hoàn lại phí hội viên?
mcq.expl:
recommend / suggest (that) somebody (should) do or recommend / suggest doing, not recommend / suggest somebody to do; Should … = If … (inversion); I shouldn’t … if I were you = advice.
recommend / suggest (that) ai đó (should) làm hoặc recommend / suggest + V-ing, không dùng recommend / suggest + ai đó + to V; Should … = If … (đảo ngữ); I shouldn’t … if I were you = lời khuyên.
Điểm ngữ pháp: demand (that) + (should) + V; không dùng demand + O + to V.
mcq.key: Why didn’t you demand ___ your subscription?|that the club refund

mcq.question: We’ve got a review today and I can’t find our latest energy consumption figures. What ___?
mcq.full: We’ve got a review today and I can’t find our latest energy consumption figures. What should I do?
mcq.vi: Hôm nay có buổi đánh giá mà tôi không tìm thấy số liệu tiêu thụ năng lượng mới nhất. Tôi nên làm gì đây?
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi xin lời khuyên → should I do?
mcq.key: We’ve got a review today and I can’t find our latest energy consumption figures. What ___?|should I do

mcq.question: I really don’t know. It’s odd that ___ just when you need them.
mcq.full: I really don’t know. It’s odd that the figures should disappear just when you need them.
mcq.vi: Tôi thật không biết. Lạ thật là số liệu lại biến mất đúng lúc cần.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: it’s odd that + should.
mcq.key: I really don’t know. It’s odd that ___ just when you need them.|the figures should disappear

mcq.question: Did you ask Rose? – Yes. She insisted that ___ all the files myself.
mcq.full: Did you ask Rose? – Yes. She insisted that I check all the files myself.
mcq.vi: Cậu hỏi Rose chưa? – Rồi. Cô ấy khăng khăng bắt tôi tự kiểm tra tất cả hồ sơ.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: insist that + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ should).
mcq.key: Did you ask Rose? – Yes. She insisted that ___ all the files myself.|I check

mcq.question: It’s important ___ his report before the meeting.
mcq.full: It’s important we discuss his report before the meeting.
mcq.vi: Điều quan trọng là chúng ta thảo luận báo cáo của anh ấy trước cuộc họp.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: important (that) + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ should).
mcq.key: It’s important ___ his report before the meeting.|we discuss

mcq.question: Shall I go and find him? – No, ___. He’s probably on his way.
mcq.full: Shall I go and find him? – No, I shouldn’t bother. He’s probably on his way.
mcq.vi: Để tôi đi tìm anh ấy nhé? – Không, tôi sẽ không bận tâm đâu. Có lẽ anh ấy đang tới.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: I shouldn’t … = lời khuyên (nếu là tôi thì tôi sẽ không …).
mcq.key: Shall I go and find him? – No, ___. He’s probably on his way.|I shouldn’t bother

mcq.question: It’s vital ___ these figures for this afternoon’s meeting.
mcq.full: It’s vital I find these figures for this afternoon’s meeting.
mcq.vi: Tối quan trọng là tôi tìm được số liệu này cho cuộc họp chiều nay.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: vital (that) + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ should).
mcq.key: It’s vital ___ these figures for this afternoon’s meeting.|I find

mcq.question: If ___, will you say I’m not available till tomorrow?
mcq.full: If anyone should call, will you say I’m not available till tomorrow?
mcq.vi: Nếu có ai gọi, cậu nói giúp là mai tôi mới rảnh nhé?
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if … should = nếu chẳng may.
mcq.key: If ___, will you say I’m not available till tomorrow?|anyone should call

mcq.question: The accountant’s recommendation is that ___ until later in the year.
mcq.full: The accountant’s recommendation is that we wait until later in the year.
mcq.vi: Khuyến nghị của kế toán là chúng ta chờ đến cuối năm.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: recommendation that + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ should).
mcq.key: The accountant’s recommendation is that ___ until later in the year.|we wait

mcq.question: He says we can’t afford anyone yet. He suggests ___ someone temporary if we really have to.
mcq.full: He says we can’t afford anyone yet. He suggests we hire someone temporary if we really have to.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy nói chưa đủ tiền thuê ai. Anh ấy đề nghị chúng ta thuê người tạm thời nếu thật sự cần.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest (that) + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ should).
mcq.key: He says we can’t afford anyone yet. He suggests ___ someone temporary if we really have to.|we hire

mcq.question: Well, I suppose it’s only natural ___ cautious.
mcq.full: Well, I suppose it’s only natural he should be cautious.
mcq.vi: Ừ, tôi nghĩ việc anh ấy thận trọng cũng là điều tự nhiên.
mcq.expl:
After insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest we can leave out should (subjunctive); should is needed after it’s odd / natural that …, in if … should, and in I shouldn’t … (advice).
Sau insist, important, vital, recommendation, suggest có thể bỏ should (giả định); cần should sau it’s odd / natural that …, trong if … should và trong I shouldn’t … (lời khuyên).
Điểm ngữ pháp: it’s natural (that) + should.
mcq.key: Well, I suppose it’s only natural ___ cautious.|he should be

mcq.question: I nearly missed the first class this morning. I should have ___.
mcq.full: I nearly missed the first class this morning. I should have set my alarm clock.
mcq.vi: Sáng nay tôi suýt lỡ tiết đầu. Lẽ ra tôi nên đặt đồng hồ báo thức.
mcq.expl:
modal + base form (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); modal + have + past participle for the past (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
động từ khuyết thiếu + nguyên mẫu (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); động từ khuyết thiếu + have + quá khứ phân từ cho quá khứ (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
Điểm ngữ pháp: should have + quá khứ phân từ.
mcq.key: I nearly missed the first class this morning. I should have ___.|set my alarm clock

mcq.question: I decided I didn’t like the shoes I’d bought, but luckily I was able to ___.
mcq.full: I decided I didn’t like the shoes I’d bought, but luckily I was able to change them.
mcq.vi: Tôi thấy không thích đôi giày đã mua, nhưng may là tôi đổi được.
mcq.expl:
modal + base form (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); modal + have + past participle for the past (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
động từ khuyết thiếu + nguyên mẫu (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); động từ khuyết thiếu + have + quá khứ phân từ cho quá khứ (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
Điểm ngữ pháp: was able to + V nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: I decided I didn’t like the shoes I’d bought, but luckily I was able to ___.|change them

mcq.question: Politicians ought not to ___.
mcq.full: Politicians ought not to make promises they can’t keep.
mcq.vi: Chính trị gia không nên hứa những điều không giữ được.
mcq.expl:
modal + base form (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); modal + have + past participle for the past (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
động từ khuyết thiếu + nguyên mẫu (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); động từ khuyết thiếu + have + quá khứ phân từ cho quá khứ (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
Điểm ngữ pháp: ought not to + V nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: Politicians ought not to ___.|make promises they can’t keep

mcq.question: Most people pass their driving test first time, so it can’t ___.
mcq.full: Most people pass their driving test first time, so it can’t be very difficult.
mcq.vi: Hầu hết mọi người đỗ sát hạch lái xe ngay lần đầu, nên nó không thể quá khó.
mcq.expl:
modal + base form (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); modal + have + past participle for the past (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
động từ khuyết thiếu + nguyên mẫu (must wear, was able to change, can’t be); động từ khuyết thiếu + have + quá khứ phân từ cho quá khứ (should have set, may have forgotten, must have been).
Điểm ngữ pháp: can’t + V nguyên mẫu (suy luận).
mcq.key: Most people pass their driving test first time, so it can’t ___.|be very difficult

mcq.question: I don’t know why my brother hasn’t phoned. He may have ___.
mcq.full: I don’t know why my brother hasn’t phoned. He may have forgotten I’m waiting for him.
mcq.vi: Tôi không biết sao anh tôi chưa gọi. Có thể anh ấy quên là tôi đang đợi.
